# Matt Pocock Skills Source

Ported from Matt Pocock's public skills repository.

- Upstream: https://github.com/mattpocock/skills
- Commit: `b8be62ffacb0118fa3eaa29a0923c87c8c11985c`
- License: MIT, preserved in `LICENSE`

This harness adapts the public, non-deprecated, non-personal skills for shared
Codex and Cursor use. Project-local artifacts are written under
`PROJECT_ROOT/.agents` instead of upstream's original project-doc layout.
